summary: Retest of post-login launcher after two fixes. ALL PASS. Backend /api/staffing/me/portal-access returns {has_staff_portal:true, full_name:'Demo Owner'} (200). Frontend: (1) Logging in at /login as owner@isodemo.com now lands on /launch and renders launcher-page with all 3 cards (launch-staff, launch-operations, launch-service_desk) — no auto-jump to /service-desk. (2) Clicking launch-staff opens /staff-portal and renders staff-my-day (greeting + 'This month' card visible) — StaffPortal fallback to /staffing/me/portal-access works for owner. (3) Clicking launch-operations navigates to /dashboard and Operations page loads. (4) REGRESSION passed: dedicated /staff-login with portal.staff@pulsedemo.test / Staff123! still lands on /staff-portal and renders staff-my-day with full new-starter profile (Alex Rivera, Fitness Instructor, Active employee). Two 404 console errors observed on /staff-portal for owner (likely /new-starter/me before fallback) but functionally masked — fallback renders My Day correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: StaffPortal.js swallows two /new-starter/me 404s before falling back — visible in browser console. Consider a HEAD/preflight or checking portal-access first to avoid the noisy 404 (cosmetic, functionality is fine).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both prior bugs (LoginRedirectPage short-circuit to /service-desk; StaffPortal 404 loop for activated staff without onboarding_case) are FIXED. Launcher chooser is shown for owner; staff card falls back to /staffing/me/portal-access; operations navigates to /dashboard; dedicated /staff-login still works. Only cosmetic issue is 2x 404 console errors from /new-starter/me before fallback.
